lines: Tokiko embraced the two young children in both arms.
Fool!! You intend to fight me with two brats in your arms like that!?
A shout could be heard from one of the Fuma as he employed his Earth Arts.
The ground between Tokiko and Ryoma had spectacularly erupted, and a cloud of dust thick enough for visibility in the area to be hindered had spread.
We're more than enough for the likes of you!
Another one unleashed his Fire Arts without giving him time to breathe.
Flames reached out like living creatures to attack Ryoma.
Though Ryoma had let out a frustrated cry, he leaped as far back as he could, ducking away from the flames.
This one's ours! Tokiko-sama, take the two of them with you, quickly!
Entrusting this fight to her subordinates without hesitation, Tokiko ran off with Kotaro and Gaiza in her arms.
Sakon! Ukon! You two with me!! You must protect them!!
The twin Fire Art users, who had sustained the least injuries so far, moved to accompany Tokiko.
You brats! You think I'll let you leave!?
We'll show you the real strength of the Fuma!!
The remaining Fuma worked together as one to stall Ryoma and his men from chasing after Tokiko.
All in order to allow Tokiko and the others to reach Asagi.
Don't get so full of yourselves, trash!!
Suddenly, some sort of black haze had begun to gush forth from Ryoma's entire body.
You guys stay out of this. I'll kill them all myself.
Ordering his subordinates to stand down, Ryoma began to sway his outstretched hands.
The black haze extended toward the Fuma members at a walking pace.
I don't know what you're trying to do, but if you think we'd get caught in thatーurghh!
One who had tried to avoid the black haze suddenly collapsed to his knees.
A separate black haze that had emerged from the ground was stickily entwining with his legs.
They were all frozen in place thanks to the back haze that swelled up out of the earth.
C-... Can't move... My strength's... being sapped?
Not quite. What's actually being sapped is your very life force.
A kunoichi caught in the mist had released a high pitched scream.
The kunoichi had long since been prepared for death, but she couldn't help but cry out from the horrific changes being wrought upon her body.
Wrinkles carved deep valleys into her face, and her hands and feetーno, all the flesh beneath the skinーwas shriveling as if rapidly aging.
The black haze was squeezing the very life out of the Fuma.
Ryoma drew closer to one of them as they writhed.
Unimpressed by his hoarse response, Ryoma snapped his fingers.
The black miasma then moved to completely envelop the Fuma, who crumbled into dust from having his last remaining life force extracted.
And just what do she plan on doing after meeting Asagi?
You know nothing... of loyalty... f-fool...
Another life was devoured by the miasma.
M-... Mas-... -ter... P-... Please... stay... safe...
I guess there's no point in asking.
All the remaining Fuma had simultaneously vanished from the world.
Whatever the Fuma remnants are up to, it's best just to keep them from seeing Asagi.
We're going after them. Whatever the case, they should be heading for Gosha Academy. Heh-heh-heh...
Beneath his red Oni Mask, Ryoma chuckled in anticipation...
